# Social Publishing

Read `docs/08-PUBLISHING-AND-SCHEDULING.md` and `docs/10-SECURITY-PRIVACY-RIGHTS.md`. Use official APIs and OAuth. Verify account eligibility, scopes, limits and media requirements from current platform documentation. Use transactional scheduling/outbox, idempotency and reconciliation. Never simulate publishing with browser automation or user passwords.
